capabilities: , Capture selected Markdown into a new TaskNotes task
Append selected Markdown to an existing TaskNotes task
Copy the current note's vault-relative directory
Route attachment links from captured selections into destination context folders
Route pasted or dropped inbox attachments from _system/_obsidian/attachments/_inbox
extras: Desktop-only. Vault Command Center and background sync commands use local Node.js process APIs.
motivation: The author built it to support a lot of the agent-focused operations I use it with.
problem: Users struggle with manually capturing notes into specific tasks, organizing attachments based on context, and running complex vault maintenance commands.
summary: TaskNotes capture, context routing, and vault command tools that automate note management and file organization.
